title: Appointed as Assistant
original: I've moved your belongings where you wanted. No worries, it wasn't heavy.

title: Talk 1
original: The shield is a symbol of a steadfast guardian.

title: Talk 2
original: I've been responsible for protecting Young Master SilverAsh... I mean, Master SilverAsh... ever since he was young.

title: Talk 3
original: It's not exactly polite to talk about Miss Enya behind her back, but... *sigh* I do pity Miss Enya for what she has suffered. She really deserves a better life.

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: If my shield gets damaged, I should take it to the artisan called Vulcan for repairs. Is that correct?

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: This is far beyond my expectation. That artisan is truly skilled. I need to thank her properly.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: Life at Rhodes Island is fun. The Snow Realm is rather bland in comparison.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: Master did send me to protect Ensia. But I honestly don't think she's the type who would sit there and ask to be protected.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: I am slowly starting to understand why Master SilverAsh holds you in such high regard. Doctor, from this day, feel free to command me as your shield.

title: Idle
original: Sometimes, I suddenly start missing my life in the Snow Realm.

title: Onboard
original: Ally, I salute you in true Snow Realm fashion. My codename is Matterhorn, and I am one of the guards dispatched here by Master SilverAsh.

title: Watching Battle Record
original: You have my gratitude.

title: Promotion 1
original: Thank you for the approval, Doctor. I am greatly flattered.

title: Promotion 2
original: I will not step back, not even if this shield shatters the very next second. Not because of my loyalty, but because of my conviction.

title: Added to Squad
original: At your service.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: I am honored.

title: Depart
original: I shall protect the team.

title: Begin Operation
original: All is ready.

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: I shall be your vanguard.

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: My shield is ready.

title: Deployment 1
original: Hm!

title: Deployment 2
original: Hoo-yah!

title: In Battle 1
original: Retribution!

title: In Battle 2
original: I'm not here just for show!

title: In Battle 3
original: With my conviction, I shall bring any monster to its knees!

title: In Battle 4
original: You don't have what it takes!

title: 4-star Result
original: I wasn't even giving my all!

title: 3-star Result
original: Their strikes can barely tickle me.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: I'll pull off a perfect victory next time for you, I promise.

title: Operation Failure
original: I should not have taken the enemies lightly. Now I pay the price.

title: Assigned to Facility
original: Very nice room, this one. Furnished tastefully, with a peaceful atmosphere.

title: Tap
original: Mhmm.

title: Trust Tap
original: This is my signature dish. How do you like it?

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: It's only natural for a guardian to keep his eyes peeled on New Year's day. Troubles do not shy away from celebration days. Rather, they are more likely to jump on people when they let their guard down. Rhodes Island is a comparatively safe place, but you must not lower your defense, Doctor. Happy new year.

title: Greeting
original: Good day, Doctor.

title: Birthday
original: It's your birthday, Doctor, isn't it? No need to worry, for I dare not forget the date. It's just the gift I prepared... I'm really not sure if you are going to appreciate it... So please, Doctor, do me a favor and open it after I leave. Thank you.

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: I'm actually not familiar with what lies outside the Snow Realm, since most of my job was to simply perform the duties my master has entrusted to me. I need to broaden my horizon. Even though I'm no more than a guardian, I need to learn more and see more.
